key.name: mode
key.description: Icon only, or album cover with title and status.

key.name: position
key.description: Where the indicator sits in the top panel.

key.name: card-bg
key.description: Follow the album art accent, or use a solid background preset.

key.name: card-bg-color
key.description: Solid palette used by the now-playing card and the panel pill.

key.name: card-open
key.description: Open on hover or only on click.

key.name: hover-delay
key.description: Milliseconds to wait before the card opens on hover.

key.name: lyrics-visible
key.description: Show synced lyrics in the now-playing card.

key.name: duck-mode
key.summary: What to do when a microphone is used
key.description: Leave playback alone, lower the volume, or pause until the microphone is free again.

key.name: duck-level
key.description: Volume percentage kept while ducking. 30 means the volume drops to 30% of its original level.

key.name: sleep-minutes
key.description: Minutes until playback fades out and pauses. Zero disables the timer.
